description: Exact Cohn–Elkies admissible function in dimension 2, Laguerre–Gaussian ansatz with m=5 forced double roots from Cohn–Elkies 2003 Table 4 (two-decimal rationals). R is a rational strictly above the isolated last odd root of G.
theorem: Cohn–Elkies 2003 Theorem 3.2: f = F(t) exp(-t/2) with t=2π|x|² satisfies f(0)=hat f(0)>0, f≤0 for |x|≥r, hat f≥0 everywhere, hence center density ≤ (r/2)^2 = R/(8π).
